fusions.name: Herd Nip
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Steam Gust
fusions.desc: Breathes a wide cone 4 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Calf at Heel
fusions.desc: Calls a grazen calf familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill you make restores 3 health.
